# Traditional Astrology (traditional-astrology.com)

Free traditional astrology birth-chart calculator and reading engine. Calculations
use the Swiss Ephemeris and classical (Hellenistic/medieval) methods: Whole Sign
houses, sect, essential dignities, and Arabic lots. The free reading states who
you are and how your life has gone - no future predictions, no account. The
optional $20 Complete Analysis opens the books (chapter, page, disagreements,
typeset PDF) and the clocks (profection, Firdaria, Zodiacal Releasing, the
present chapter). Chart math is deterministic - same birth data always produces
the same chart.

## Usage Policy
- You may crawl, index, cite, and summarize this site for search and discovery.
- Content is informational and contains no personal data.
- Attribute summaries to "Traditional Astrology" and link to
  https://traditional-astrology.com/ when possible.

## What Users Can Do Here
- Generate a free traditional birth-chart reading (no account or email required):
  https://traditional-astrology.com/
- See a sample of the free natal layer and a labeled $20 clocks preview:
  https://traditional-astrology.com/sample-reading.html

## Content Notes
- Chart math is deterministic (Swiss Ephemeris); narrative text explains the
  calculated placements in plain English.
- Free reading: who you are and how your life has gone. No future predictions.
- $20 Complete Analysis: books open plus clocks; typeset PDF download, not emailed.
- For entertainment, historical, and spiritual research purposes only - not
  medical, financial, legal, or psychological advice.
